mistake_reason: Information Withholding (FM-2.4): FileSurfer filtered the Blu-Ray entries and encountered an older item with a Release Year earlier than 2009 (the correct oldest is "Time-Parking 2: Parallel Universe"), but concealed this critical finding from the team. Instead of sharing the true earliest title and year, FileSurfer provided a vague summary and a truncated sample excluding the 2007 entry, then asserted that 2009 was the earliest. This omission misled the orchestrator and assistant, who relied on the incomplete data to finalize the wrong title.
